nativeTitle: V3 forward assembly trial | V1 V2 port routing | Round3 lenses | horizontal XY

layoutConstraints.meaning: Preserve V1/V2 longitudinal input and pre-fold output, then downward final output. External input and output propagation are perpendicular, as in the reference layouts.

mechanical.scope: 532 sampled poses, input center and 48 boundary rays at radii 1.5 and 2.5 mm; conservative motor/shaft capsules and moving mirror boxes. Motor dimensions are reservations, not selected vendor CAD. Lens mounts, connectors, fasteners, cables, enclosure and continuous sweeps not accepted.
